Romantic Charm

Mackinac Island

A HistoricTreasure

Built by Magdelaine Laframboise in 1820, Harbour View Inn was an iconic summer cottage on the island into the 1990s. Now a fashionable hotel nestled among other grand cottages and opulent mansions, the Harbour View Inn offers a welcoming and comfortable stay on charming Mackinac Island.

An Unparalleled Escape

Top Reasons to Stay

Central to Everything

Located on exquisite, scenic, and peaceful grounds, you are a short, leisurely stroll or a bike ride away from Mackinac Island’s best attractions, shops and restaurants.

Learn More 1 / 3

A Hidden Gem

Mackinac Island still maintains its “best kept secret” allure and that’s just how we like it. Gorgeously bestowed with plenty of natural beauty, history, character and a gentile island charm, discover what we locals have known for generations.

2 / 3

If These Walls Could Talk

Immersed in history and rooted in legacy, come discover the Harbour View Inn’s gallant past and two centuries’ worth of fascinating stories all of its own.

3 / 3

All the Buzz!

Beautiful Hotel at Edge of Town

“This is a beautiful hotel towards the edge of town with nice views of the harbor. Very clean and comfortable. They have bike rentals that are cheaper than most places in town. Nice breakfasts each morning. Staff are very helpful.”
Bruce

Excellent Hotel

“My wife and I booked a two-night stay on Mackinac Island to rest and relax after dropping our kids off at college. It was a last-minute decision and I think the Harbor View Inn had the only remaining room left on the island....and what a pleasant surprise. We couldn't have been happier with our stay.”
Rob B.

Great Stay.
